summary: A one-page storefront for a fictional Houston skincare maker, with six products, full ingredient lists, a morning and evening routine guide, and buy buttons that would link to the brand's own checkout.
highlights: Six products with size, price, skin types and key ingredients, each with its own buy button
Full ingredient lists as real text, plus a plain-English glossary
Morning and evening routine guide that tells customers what to use and in what order
Careful wording: cosmetic benefits only, a patch-test note, and clear shipping and returns
